#!/bin/sh

. /lib/functions.sh
. ../netifd-proto.sh
init_proto "$@"

proto_ndk_dhcpv6_init_config() {
    renew_handler=1

    proto_config_add_string 'ifname'                   #---- interface device name eth1.980
    proto_config_add_string 'ndk_config_file'          #---- -c configure file name
    proto_config_add_int "ndk_addr_type"               #---- -A hd6_address_method   0/1/2/3  int
    proto_config_add_string 'ndk_vendor_class'         #---- -V option16 buffer  string  Vendor Class
    proto_config_add_boolean ndk_aftr                  #---- -O dhcp6c_option_aftr_switch enable/disable
    proto_config_add_boolean ndk_iana                  #---- IANA  enable/disable
    proto_config_add_boolean ndk_iapd                  #---- IAPD  enable/disable
    proto_config_add_boolean ndk_oro                   #---- Option Request option now support dns and dnsl 
    proto_config_add_boolean ndk_rapid                 #---- rapid commit list  enable/disable
    proto_config_add_boolean ndk_reconfigure           #---- reconfigure accept  enable/disable
    proto_config_add_int "ndk_iana_id"                 #---- send ia-na $ndk_ianaid
    proto_config_add_int "ndk_iapd_id"                 #---- send ia-pd $ndk_iapdid
    proto_config_add_int "ndk_sla_id"                  #---- sla-id $ndk_slaid;
    proto_config_add_int "ndk_sla_len"                 #---- sla-len $ndk_slalen;
    proto_config_add_int "ndk_t1_hint"                 #---- a hint value for T1
    proto_config_add_int "ndk_t2_hint"                 #---- a hint value for T2
    proto_config_add_boolean ndk_autoconfig            #---- auto configure enable/disable
    proto_config_add_boolean ndk_managed               #---- managed flag in router advertisement message
    proto_config_add_boolean ndk_other                 #---- other flag in router advertisement message
    proto_config_add_boolean ndk_opt16_enabled         #---- Option16 Enabled
    proto_config_add_string 'ndk_opt16_vendorid'       #---- Option16 VendorID

}

proto_ndk_dhcpv6_setup() {
    local config="$1"
    local iface="$2"

    local ifname ndk_config_file ndk_addr_type ndk_vendor_class ndk_aftr ndk_iana ndk_iapd ndk_oro ndk_rapid ndk_reconfigure ndk_iana_id ndk_iapd_id ndk_sla_id ndk_sla_len ndk_t1_hint ndk_t2_hint
    json_get_vars ifname ndk_config_file ndk_addr_type ndk_vendor_class ndk_aftr ndk_iana ndk_iapd ndk_oro ndk_rapid ndk_reconfigure ndk_iana_id ndk_iapd_id ndk_sla_id ndk_sla_len ndk_t1_hint ndk_t2_hint ndk_opt16_enabled ndk_opt16_vendorid

    local ndk_autoconfig ndk_managed ndk_other
    json_get_vars ndk_autoconfig ndk_managed ndk_other

    #configure cmd opts
    local opts=""

    echo "" > /tmp/wan6.log
    date >> /tmp/wan6.log
    [ -n "$ndk_config_file" ] || {
        echo "configure file for ndk_dhcp6c is NULL !!!" >> /tmp/wan6.log
        return
    }

    append opts "-A $ndk_addr_type"
    [ -n "$ndk_vendor_class" ] && append opts "-V $ndk_vendor_class"
    [ "$ndk_aftr" = "1" ] && append opts "-O"
    [ "$ndk_opt16_enabled" = "1" -a -n "$ndk_opt16_vendorid" ] && append opts "-X $ndk_opt16_vendorid"

    #configure ndk_dhcp6c configuration flile
    [ -e "$ndk_config_file" ] && {
        rm -rf "$ndk_config_file"
    }

    local automode=${ndk_autoconfig:-0}
    local mflag=${ndk_managed:-0}
    local oflag=${ndk_other:-0}

    if [ "$automode" = "1" ]; then
        if [ -z "$ndk_managed" -o -z "$ndk_other" ]; then
            echo "M or O flags is not set in Auto model, dhcp6c wait for start!!!" >> /tmp/wan6.log

            proto_export "INTERFACE=$config"
            # add stub parameter -S to indicate dhcp6c will run in stub mode
            proto_run_command "$config" ndk_dhcp6c -S $iface
            exit 0
        else
            ndk_iana=$mflag
            ndk_oro=$oflag
        fi
    fi

    echo "interface $ifname {" > $ndk_config_file
    [ "$ndk_oro" = "1" ] && echo "    request domain-name-servers,domain-name;"  >> $ndk_config_file
    [ "$ndk_iapd" = "0" -a "$ndk_iana" = "0" ] && echo "    information-only;" >> $ndk_config_file

    [ "$ndk_iapd" = "1" ] && echo "    send ia-pd $ndk_iapd_id;"  >> $ndk_config_file
    [ "$ndk_iana" = "1" ] && echo "    send ia-na $ndk_iana_id;"  >> $ndk_config_file
    [ "$ndk_rapid" = "1" ] && echo "    send rapid-commit;"  >> $ndk_config_file
    [ "${ndk_t1_hint:=0}" -gt 0  ] && echo  "    t1 $ndk_t1_hint;"  >> $ndk_config_file
    [ "${ndk_t2_hint:=0}" -gt 0  ] && echo  "    t2 $ndk_t2_hint;"  >> $ndk_config_file

    [ "${ndk_reconfigure:-0}" = "1" ] && echo "    send reconfigure-accept;" >> $ndk_config_file

    echo "};" >> $ndk_config_file

    [ "$ndk_iana" = "1" ] && {
        if [ $ndk_iana_id -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "id-assoc na $ndk_iana_id {" >> $ndk_config_file
        else
            echo "id-assoc na {" >> $ndk_config_file
        fi
        echo "};" >> $ndk_config_file
    }

    [ "$ndk_iapd" = "1" ] && {
        if [ $ndk_iapd_id -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "id-assoc pd $ndk_iapd_id {" >> $ndk_config_file
        else
            echo "id-assoc pd {" >> $ndk_config_file
        fi
        echo "    prefix-interface $ifname {" >> $ndk_config_file
        echo "        sla-id $ndk_sla_id;" >> $ndk_config_file
        echo "        sla-len $ndk_sla_len;" >> $ndk_config_file
        echo "    };" >> $ndk_config_file
        echo "};" >> $ndk_config_file
    }

    proto_export "INTERFACE=$config"

    proto_run_command "$config" ndk_dhcp6c \
        -s /lib/netifd/ndk_dhcpv6.script \
        $opts -c $ndk_config_file $iface 
}

proto_ndk_dhcpv6_renew() {
    local interface="$1"
    # SIGUSR1 forces ndk_dhcp6c to renew its lease
    local sigusr1="$(kill -l SIGUSR1)"
    [ -n "$sigusr1" ] && proto_kill_command "$interface" $sigusr1
}

proto_ndk_dhcpv6_teardown() {
    local interface="$1"
    proto_kill_command "$interface"
}

add_protocol ndk_dhcpv6

notify_dhcpv6_status_change_to_evtmgr()
{
    json_init
    json_add_string msg "wan_msg_dhcp6c_state_changed"
    json_add_object "in"
    json_add_object "dhcp6c"
    json_add_object "state"
        json_add_int pid_dhcp6c "${pid:-0}"
        json_add_int prefix_assigned  "${prefix_assigned:-0}"
        json_add_int addr_assigned  "${addr_assigned:-0}"
        json_add_int dns_assigned  "${dns_assigned:-0}"              #domain-name-server
        json_add_int dns_search_assigned  "${dnsl_assigned:-0}"      #domain-name-search-list
        json_add_int aftr_assigned  "${aftr_assigned:-0}"            #aftr_assigned
        #json_add_int addr_cmd "${addr_cmd:-0}"                       #address cmd default 0-add/1-delete
        [ "${addr_cmd:-0}" -eq 0 ] && json_add_string addr_cmd "add"
        [ "${addr_cmd:-0}" -eq 1 ] && json_add_string addr_cmd "del"

        #address info object
        [ -n "$address" ] && {
            json_add_object "addr_info"
            json_add_string ip6addr "$address"
            json_add_int pltime "${addr_ptime:-0}"                   #prefix p time default 0
            json_add_int vltime "${addr_vtime:-0}"                   #prefix v time default 0
            json_close_object
        }
        #json_add_int prefix_cmd "${prefix_cmd:-0}"                   #prefix cmd default 0-add/1-delete
        [ "${prefix_cmd:-0}" -eq 0 ] && json_add_string prefix_cmd "add"
        [ "${prefix_cmd:-0}" -eq 1 ] && json_add_string prefix_cmd "del"

        #prefix info object
        [ -n "$prefix" ] && {
            json_add_object "prefix_info"
            json_add_string ip6prefix "$prefix"                      #prefix/mask
            json_add_int pltime "${prefix_ptime:-0}"                 #prefix p time default 0
            json_add_int vltime "${prefix_vtime:-0}"                 #prefix v time default 0
            json_close_object
        }
        #[ -n "$pd_address" ] && json_add_string pd_address "$pd_address"
        [ -n "$dns" ] && json_add_string dns "$dns"
        [ -n "$dnsl" ] && json_add_string dns_search "$dnsl"
        [ -n "$aftr" ] && json_add_string aftrname "$aftr"
        [ -n "$ifname" ] && json_add_string ifname "$ifname"
        json_add_string interface "$INTERFACE"

    json_close_object #close state
    json_close_object #close dhcp6c
    json_close_object #close in
    json_close_object

    ubus send dhcp6c_state_changed_msg "$(json_dump)"
}

notify_dhcpv6_status_change_to_evtmgr

exit 0

#!/bin/sh
# ramond.sh - notify ra info to netifd and wand
# run as ramond.sh interface add fe80::1234
# Copyright (c) 2020 ndk

[ -z "$1" ] && echo "Error: should be run by rgstack" && exit 1
. /lib/functions.sh
. /lib/netifd/netifd-proto.sh

ndk_ra_notify_gw_info()
{
    local iface=$1
    local action=$2
    local gw_addr=$3
    local ifname=$4

    [ -z  $iface -o -z $action -o -z $gw_addr ] && return

    json_init
    json_add_string msg "wan_msg_ramond_notify_gateway"
    json_add_object "in"
    json_add_object "ramond"
    json_add_object "gateway"
        json_add_string action "$action"
        json_add_string ip6gw "$gw_addr"
        json_add_string ifname "$ifname"
        json_add_string interface "$iface"
    json_close_object #close geteway
    json_close_object #close ramond
    json_close_object #close in
    json_close_object

    ubus send ramond_notify_gateway_msg "$(json_dump)"
}

ndk_ra_notify_ipaddr_info()
{
    local iface=$1
    local wanid=$2
    local ifname=$3
    local isadd=$4
    local ipaddr=$5
    local preflen=$6

    [ -z  $iface -o -z $ipaddr ] && return

    json_init
    json_add_string msg "wan_msg_ramond_change_ip"
    json_add_object "in"
    json_add_object "ramond"
    json_add_object "address"
        json_add_int wanid "$wanid"
        json_add_string add "$isadd"
        json_add_string ip6addr "$ipaddr"
        json_add_int prefix_len "${preflen:-0}"
        json_add_string ifname "$ifname"
        json_add_string interface "$iface"
    json_close_object #close address
    json_close_object #close ramond
    json_close_object #close in
    json_close_object

    ubus send ramond_change_ip_msg "$(json_dump)"
}

ndk_ra_notify_start_dhcp6c()
{
    local iface=$1
    local wanid=$2
    local ifname=$3
    local start=$4
    local mflag=$5
    local oflag=$6

    [ -z  $iface -o -z $ifname ] && return

    json_init
    json_add_string msg "wan_msg_ramond_start_dhcp6c"
    json_add_object "in"
    json_add_object "ramond"
    json_add_object "dhcp6c"
        json_add_int wanid "$wanid"
        json_add_int start "${start:-0}"
        json_add_int m_flag "${mflag:-0}"
        json_add_int o_flag "${oflag:-0}"
        json_add_string ifname "$ifname"
        json_add_string interface "$iface"
    json_close_object #close dhcp6c
    json_close_object #close ramond
    json_close_object #close in
    json_close_object

    ubus send ramond_start_dhcp6c_msg "$(json_dump)"
}

ndk_ra_notify_prefix_info()
{
    local iface=$1

    [ -z  $iface -o -z $ifname ] && return

    json_init
    json_add_string msg "wan_msg_ramond_notify_prefix"
    json_add_object "in"
    json_add_object "ramond"
    json_add_object "prefix"
        json_add_int wanid "$wanid"
        json_add_string add "$is_add"
        json_add_string ifname "$ifname"
        json_add_object "prefix_info"
            json_add_string ip6prefix "$prefix"
            json_add_int pltime "${ptime:-0}"
            json_add_int vltime "${vtime:-0}"
            json_add_int onlink "${lflag:-0}"
            json_add_int autonomous "${aflag:-0}"
        json_close_object # prefix_info
        json_add_int prefix_len "${prefix_len:-0}"
        json_add_string interface "$iface"
    json_close_object #close prefix
    json_close_object #close ramond
    json_close_object #close in
    json_close_object

    ubus send ramond_notify_prefix_msg "$(json_dump)"
}

usage()
{
        echo "Usage: support message type:"
        echo "    gateway [Interface] [action] [gateway address]"
        echo "    ipaddr [Interface] [wanid] [add?] [address] [prefix len]"
        echo "    dhcp6c [Interface] [wanid] [ifname] [start?] [mflag] [oflag]"
        echo "    prefix [Interface] [{setenvs}] " 
        echo "    [-h show this message]"
        exit 1
}

case "$1" in
    gateway)
        ndk_ra_notify_gw_info $2 $3 $4 $5
        ;;

    ipaddr)
        ndk_ra_notify_ipaddr_info $2 $3 $4 $5 $6 $7
        ;;

    dhcp6c)
        ndk_ra_notify_start_dhcp6c $2 $3 $4 $5 $6 $7
        ;;

    prefix)
        ndk_ra_notify_prefix_info $2
        ;;

    *)
        usage
        ;;
esac

#!/bin/sh
[ -z "$1" ] && echo "Error: should be run by ndk_stack" && exit 1
. /lib/functions.sh
. /lib/netifd/netifd-proto.sh

notify_interface()
{
    #dns
    [ -n "$dhcp_dns" ] && {
        local dnses="${dhcp_dns//,/ }"
        for s_dns in $dnses; do
            proto_add_dns_server "$s_dns"
        done
    }

    #domain search list
    [ -n "$dhcp_dsl" ] && {
        local dnsls="${dhcp_dsl//,/ }"
        for s_dnsl in $dnsls; do
            proto_add_dns_search "$s_dnsl"
        done
    }

#    [ -n "$gateway" ] && {
#        proto_add_ipv6_route "::" "64" "$gateway" "1024"
#    }

    for s_prefix in $dhcp_prefix; do
        local pmask=64
#        proto_add_ipv6_prefix "$s_prefix"
        proto_add_ipv6_prefix "$s_prefix/$pmask,$dhcp_prefix_ptime,$dhcp_prefix_vtime"

#        [ -n "$gateway" ] && {
#            proto_add_ipv6_route "::" 0 "$gateway" "1024" "$dhcp_prefix_vtime" "$s_prefix/$pmask"
#        }
    done

    for addr in $dhcp_addr; do
        local mask=128
        proto_add_ipv6_address "$addr" "$mask" "$dhcp_ptime" "$dhcp_vtime" 1

#        [ -n "$gateway" ] && {
#            proto_add_ipv6_route "::" 0 "$gateway" "1024" "$dhcp_vtime" "$addr/$mask"
#        }
     done

    for raddr in $ra_addr; do
        local rmask=64
        proto_add_ipv6_address "$raddr" "$rmask" "$ra_ptime" "$ra_vtime" 1

#        [ -n "$gateway" ] && {
#            proto_add_ipv6_route "::" 0 "$gateway" "1024" "$ra_vtime" "$raddr/$rmask"
#        }
    done
}


notify_wan6_data()
{
    local interface=$1
    local data_string="$2"

    msg=`jshn -r $data_string`

    proto_add_data
    eval ${msg:11}
    proto_close_data

    proto_send_update "$interface"
    local ret=$?
    # check ret of ubus $options call network.interface notify_proto "$(json_dump)"
    if [ $ret -ne 0 ]; then
      echo $ret > /tmp/emgr_script_failed
    fi
}

setup_interface()
{
    proto_init_update "*" 1
    notify_interface
    notify_wan6_data $1 $2
}

teardown_interface()
{
    local interface=$1
    proto_init_update "*" 0
    proto_send_update "$interface"
    local ret=$?
    # check ret of ubus $options call network.interface notify_proto "$(json_dump)"
    if [ $ret -ne 0 ]; then
      echo $ret > /tmp/emgr_script_failed
    fi
}

usage()
{
        echo "Usage: support message type:"
        echo "  setup_interface:[Interface] [json string for setup interface]"
        echo "  teardown_interface:[Interface] "
        echo "  no parameter:[show this message]"
        exit 1
}

parameters=$#

rm -f /tmp/emgr_script_failed
case $parameters in
    1)
        teardown_interface $1
        ;;
    2)
        setup_interface $1 $2
        ;;
    *)
        usage
        ;; 
esac

exit 0

################### Start of a rule block #############################
# Index of the rule
#RULE = GROUPNAME_RULENAME
RULE = service_ndk_ramond

# Condition to start rule, existence of one of the following
#
# NONE - No start condition, application is spawn immediately
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# RULE_COMPLETED id - Rule id completed successfully
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# ENV_VAR name, value - Value of a variable
#
#START_COND = { NONE; FILE filename; PNAME pname; RULE_COMPLETED id; NETDEVICE netdev; IPC_OWNER owner, STATUS script, status }
START_COND = RULE_COMPLETED service_msgmgr

# Command with parameters, NONE for sync point
#COMMAND = cmd parameters...
COMMAND = /sbin/ndk_ramond

# Scheduling (priority) of the process
#SCHED = { NICE value; FIFO value }
SCHED = NICE 0

# Daemon flag ¨C Process must not end
#DAEMON = { YES, NO }
DAEMON = YES

# Condition to end rule and move to next rule, wait for one of the following:
#
# NONE - No monitor on the result, just spawn application and continue.
# FILE filename - The existence of a file
# EXIT status - The application exited with status. Other statuses are considered failure
# NETDEVICE netdev - The existence of a networking device
# IPC_OWNER owner - The existence of an IPC destination point
# PROCESS_READY ¨C The process sent a READY event though PCD API.
# WAIT msecs - Delay, ignore END_COND_TIMEOUT
#
#END_COND = { NONE; FILE filename; EXIT status; NETDEVICE netdev; IPC_OWNER owner; WAIT msecs; PROCESS_READY }
END_COND = NONE

# Timeout for end condition. Fail if timeout expires. -1 if not relevant.
#END_COND_TIMEOUT = msecs
END_COND_TIMEOUT = -1

# Action upon failure, do one of the following actions upon failure
# NONE ¨C Do not take any action
# REBOOT - Reboot the system
# RESTART - Restart the rule
# EXEC_RULE id - Execute a rule
#
#FAILURE_ACTION = { NONE, REBOOT, RESTART, EXEC_RULE id }
FAILURE_ACTION = RESTART

# if RESTART is followed by a number, it will the number of restart allowed in FAILURE_RESET_COUNT hour(s). After this number of fail, the action will be definitively NONE.
# Action upon second failure (only if the first one is RESTART), do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION2 = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
# Action upon next failures (only if the second one is RESTART), do one of the following actions upon failure 
# FAILURE_ACTION_NEXT = {NONE | REBOOT | RESTART | EXEC_RULE} 
# Interval in seconds between a failure and the next failure action.
# FAILURE_INTERVAL = (0..4294967)
# Time in hours before resetting the failure counter. 0: use only the first failure action.
# FAILURE_RESET_COUNT = (0..1193)

# Rule is Active or not (To be activated later by PCD API)
#ACTIVE = { YES, NO }
ACTIVE = YES

# User id for the process
# USER = { UID | User name }

# ping time out ,Fail if timeout expires.
# ALIVE_TIMEOUT = 10000
################### End of a rule block #############################
